title: Mr Matthew Wood – HC Review Decision – 31 May 2024
text:
IN THE MATTER BETWEEN

GENERAL OSTEOPATHIC COUNCIL
and
MATTHEW WOOD

Conditions of Practice Imposed on Matthew Wood on 31 August 2023 by
the Health Committee

You, Matthew Wood, must:
1. Remain under the care of and comply with the advice and directions of your
, and to cease work immediately if so advised;

2. Show a copy of these conditions to your
team and to any
potential osteopathic employer or potential osteopathic business partner;

3. Inform the GOsC immediately if you are discharged by your existing

team;

4. Secure a report from your
key worker for submission to the
GOsC prior to the expiry of this order, about progress in relation to your
, your compliance with

6. Arrange and undertake testing of a non-segmented hair sample for the recent
and long term ingestion of

a maximum of three months

8.
